entries.en: smoke; smoke from a fire

entries.zh: 烟；熏烟（火熏所生之气，亦指烟炱）
entries.en: smoke; smoke from burning; sooty smoke
smoke; fumes

entries.zh: （疑）昏沉、郁闷（令人昏眩的郁气）
entries.en: (doubtful) giddiness; melancholy vapours; low spirits
entries.notes: 西语 humos 可指致人昏眩的「郁气」，汉字栏自标疑、音写末字不明，只能存其大意。

entries.en: to sink; to cave in; to subside

entries.zh: 凹陷；陷下去（原条音写残损，仅存大意）
entries.en: to sink in; to be dented (text partly illegible)
entries.notes: 音写栏标残、逐词难辨，释义仅据汉字「凹」与西语 hundirse 定其大意。

entries.en: to sink in the water; to go under

entries.zh: 崩塌、倒塌（房屋、土地下陷）
entries.en: to collapse; to fall in (of a house or the ground)
to sink into mud; to sink in (of soft ground)

entries.zh: 两船相撞而沉没；船沉入水中
entries.en: to founder (of two ships colliding); to sink
entries.notes: 音写首音节与「舸」不甚相合且有污损，仅依西语「两船相撞而沉」定其义。

entries.en: a sunken or hollow thing (e.g. a flat nose)
entries.notes: 汉字栏「躡/躍」皆与「凹陷」不合，仅西语 ut narices（如鼻）提示塌鼻义，故存疑。

entries.en: to subside; to cave in (of the ground)
the hollows of the skull to sink in; sunken bone hollows
entries.notes: casco 有头颅、蹄壳、船壳诸义，此处依汉字「骨髓凹」取头颅骨窝义。

entries.en: to sink one's foot in; to step into a hollow
to sink; to founder (of a ship)
to sink; to founder (of a ship)
entries.notes: 汉字栏「膠流水」与音写难确解，释义仅依西语词头「船沉没」。

entries.en: to capsize; to turn turtle; to be overturned
entries.notes: 汉字栏末字疑为「縛」，词义依西语 bolverse boca abajo「底朝天」定为翻覆。

entries.zh: 凹陷下去；软物受压下陷（泛指陷落）
entries.en: to sink in; to give way, to cave in (of something soft)
to steal; to snatch away, to rob
entries.notes: 汉字栏「損/搶」未定，西语 hurtar 与 arrebatar 并列，故二义并存。

entries.en: to steal
entries.notes: 汉字「極」与词义不合，释义依西语 hurtar 及音写栏首音节（当为「偷」）而定。
